sam_platform: Heads-up — we need to decide default routing behavior for requests with missing/unknown X-Client-Version. Product wants the least-surprising UX in Console but infra is worried about quota spikes.
jordan_pm: Can you sketch the options?
maria-p: TL;DR: two choices — strict-deny (400 + instruct to upgrade) or permissive-fallthrough (route to v2-compatible variant with quota applied).
alex.dev: Strict-deny avoids silent behavior but breaks a lot of flaky clients. Permissive reduces breakage but can blow through v2 quotas if clients are old.
lee_ux: From a UX POV, Console should show a per-route banner saying "Unknown client version: routing in compatibility mode" and offer a one-click pin to force v1/v2.
ops_tara: If we do permissive-fallthrough we need a smoothing window and a circuit-breaker. Otherwise queued traffic + retries could spike Dedicated usage.
sre-bot: Incident: last permissive test produced a 2.3x token spike in EU region for 15m (see logs: `region=eu tokens=2.3x window=15m`). :warning:
jordan_pm: Noted. Is there a telemetry signal we can add to detect risky silent fallthrough quickly?
alex.dev: We can emit metric: compat.fallthrough.count by tenant+route and compat.fallthrough.sev (samples of request headers + seq_len distribution). That should let us threshold.
maria-p: Also need console telemetry surface: show rate, % of requests missing version, and top client strings (User-Agent).
lee_ux: UI mock: small pill in route details that flips from green -> amber -> red based on fallthrough.rate. Click expands sample clients and a one-click opt-out.
ops_tara: Agree on pill. For rollout: suggest default = permissive for 2 weeks while sampling clients at 1% of requests for strict-deny responses (so we can estimate real breakage). After 2w, change default to strict-deny for new tenants.
sam_platform: That hybrid sounds reasonable. What about quotas? If permissive routing maps unknowns to v2, do they get v2 quotas or a blended quota?
alex.dev: We can allocate them to a "compat" quota bucket with a cap at, say, 25% of the route's normal v2 throughput. If exceeded, circuit-breaker trips and we fall back to 429 + guidance header. Implementable in routing layer as: `if unknown_version -> apply bucket=route:compat:v2`
ops_tara: Circuit-breaker policy should be tenant-scoped and asynchronous alerting for >80% usage for 5m.
sre-bot: Added alert rule: compat_quota_util > 0.8 for 5m -> pager to oncall.
deploy-bot: FYI deploy queued: feature/compat-routing will be on staging @ 8pm PST.
jordan_pm: Action items: 1) infra to add compat metrics + quota bucket (alex, ops_tara). 2) Console pill + samples (lee_ux, maria-p). 3) PM to publish migration guidance + 1% sampling plan (jordan_pm). 4) Run permissive default for 2w then re-evaluate.
maria-p: I'll draft the Console copy and migration doc later today. :memo:
alex.dev: I'll start the metric and bucket prototype, will post snippets in this thread.
lee_ux: I'll attach mocks to the route details PR.
ops_tara: I'll wire the alert and sketch circuit-breaker thresholds.
sam_platform: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after staging deploy and first day of sampling. :eyes:
